assertion: Seeded SVG noise supports fractal and turbulence modes, independent axes, octaves, color spaces and seamless stitched tiles.

browser.reason: SVG seeded tables and stitching match Chrome/WebKit. Use their pixel sampling phase; Firefox samples one pixel earlier. Float16 intermediates differ from browser noise quantization mostly by 1 channel level (389 pixels exceed 1, only 2 reach 6), most visibly when low alpha is converted to linear RGB.
